paite: Akum sagih kum in Jehoiada akihatsak a, sepaih zaheutu, Jehoram tapa Azariah, Jehohanan tapa Ishmael, Obed tapa Azariah, Adaiah tapa Maaseiah, Jikri tapa Elisaphath kiang ah thu akhung hi.
heading: Athaliah Kalh A Helna / (2 Kum 11.4-16)
english: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam ah avak ua, Judah gam kho chih a Levite leh Israel inkuan intekte akaikhawm ua, Jerusalem ava tungtou uhi.
english: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

paite: Kikaikhawmte tengteng in Pathian inn ah kumpipa kiang ah thu akhung uhi. Huan akiang uah, "Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N David tapate tungtang thu ana gen bang in kumpipa tapa in vai ahawm ding ahi.
english: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the sons of David.

paite: Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi, siampute leh Levite Sabbath ni a hong kuansekte seh thum a khen seh khat kongkhak ngak mite na hi ding ua;
english: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

paite: seh thum a khen seh khat kumpipa' inn ah na om ding ua; huan seh thum a khen seh khat kulh kongpi ah; mipi tengteng bel TOUPA intual sung ah a-om ding uh.
english: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Himahleh, siampute leh nasemmi Levite kia lou ngal kuamah TOUPA' inn ah lut kei un, amau bel asiangthou ziak un alut ding ua, mipi tengteng bel TOUPA hungaih in a-om ding uhi.
english: But let no one come into Yahweh’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow Yahweh’s instructions.

paite: Levite'n agalvan uh tawi in kumpipa a-um ding ua; kuapeuh inn a hong lut thah ding ahi a; huan kumpipa apawt leh alut in amah kiang ah om zel un," achi hi.
english: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

paite: Huchi in Levite leh Judah tengteng in siampu Jehoiada thupiak bang in ahih ua; amaute heute chiat Sabbath ni a hong kuan dingte leh Sabbath ni a tawp dingte api ua; siampu Jehoiada in atawp ding pawl lah atawpsak nai kei hi.
heading: Joash Kumpi A Bawlna
english: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in sepaih za heutute ToUPA' inn a om kumpipa David tei leh lum neu leh lum liante apia hi.
english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

paite: Huan mite galvan tawi chiat in taklam sang a kipan in veilam sang tan in maitam leh inn um in kumpipa a-umsak uhi.
english: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia ua, lallukhu akhusak ua, theihsakna thu apia ua, kumpipa in abawl ua, Jehoiada leh atapate'n thau anilh ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Athaliah in mipi kumpipa pahtawi a mipi kiphu motmot husa azak in TOUPA' inn ah mipi lak ah ava hoh hi.
heading: Athaliah Thahna
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

paite: A-en a, ngai in, kongpi a khuambul ah kumpipa adingh a, akiang ah sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite toh; huai gam a mi tengteng in nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkulte amut zuazua ua; lasa mite'n athil gingtheite uh tum in phatna la asakhawm uhi. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Kiphialgukna; kiphialgukna ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

paite: Huan siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutu dia seh sepaih za heutute apikhia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak unla, huan kuapeuh azuizui namsau a satlup hi hen," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn ah zaw thah ding ahi kei," achita hi.
english: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in lampi a-awn ua, sakol lutna kongpi ah kumpipa' inn ah ahoh a, huai ah athat uhi.
english: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

paite: Huan Jehoiada in amah leh mipi tengteng leh kumpipa kikal ah TOUPA mite hi ding in thu akhung hi.
heading: Jehoiada Puahthakna / (2 Kum 11.17-20)
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh’s people.

paite: Mipi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihsia ua, amaitamte, alimte ahihtam dimdem ua, Baal siampu Matan, maitam bul ah athat uhi.
english: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

paite: Jehoiada in, Mosi Dan Bu a gelh bang a nuamsatak leh la sa kawm a, David in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat lan ding a ana seh siampu Levite nuai a sem ding in David thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ngakmi dingte asep hi.
english: Jehoiada appointed the officers of Yahweh’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in Yahweh’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

paite: Siangthou lou peuhmah alutlouhna ding un TOUPA' inn kongkhak ngak mite asep hi.
english: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

paite: Huan zakhat tung a heutute, mihoihte, mipi uk mite, huai gammi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa apikhia ua; kongkhak saknungzaw ah kumpipa' inn lam ah ahoh ua, kumpipa agam laltutphah ah atusakta uhi.
english: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from Yahweh’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in namsau a Athaliah athah nung un huai gam a mi tengteng nuamsatak in a-om ua, khopi galmuang in a-omta hi.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.
